gloss: cause to break or burst forth, break forth with
definition: פָּצַח verb cause to break or burst forth, break forth with (compare Arabic break, crush ; Ethiopic shatter ; Syriac is be joyous, hilarious ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural פָּֽצְחוּ רִנָּה Isa 14:7 they have broken forth with joyous shout; Imperfect יִפְצְחוּ רִנָּה Isa 55:12 (of mountains); Imperative feminine singular פִּצְחִי רִנָּה Isa 54:1 (of Zion); masculine plural ׳ פִּצְחוּ ר Isa 44:23 ; Isa 49:13 Qr (> Kt יפצחו ; of mountains); absolute פִּצְחוּ Isa 52:9 ; Ps 98:4 (both + רַנְּנוּ ). Pi`el break bones in pieces: Perfect 3 plural פִּצֵּ֑חוּ Mic 3:3 .
